QuestInfo.name: Watcha looking at?!
QuestInfo.0: You don't know why, but a scary-looking beggar is staring at you. Maybe you should ask why he's staring...
QuestInfo.1: #p9310537# isn't a beggar but an antique merchant! \r\nHe told you to bring any rare items you find to him and only him. He said he'll give a good price... but you're not sure you believe him.
